autonomous_wave.goal: Close the process-termination gap between export publication and lifecycle metadata registration with a durable lane-local handoff journal and deterministic relaunch convergence.
autonomous_wave.rationale: AW09 could compensate only when the same process reached its catch block. A process death after export publication could still leave unregistered bytes. Core Data query tuning was lower-value without Apple runtime evidence, so relaunch durability was selected first.
autonomous_wave.done_when: Validated Exports/** are journaled before metadata registration, active same-process intents are protected from actor-reentrant recovery, relaunch preserves fully registered audio, safely compensates wholly unregistered audio, fails closed for partial/corrupt states, portable recovery tests/benchmark/evidence pass, and Apple/device/PARITY gates remain explicit.
